gloss: to be based on; to take into account; to consider

definitions.gloss: to be based on; to take into account
definitions.explanation: To use something as a foundation or basis for an action, decision, or argument.

examples.japanese: {結果|けっか}を{踏|ふ}まえて{判断|はんだん}する。
examples.english: I'll make a decision based on the results.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}の{経験|けいけん}を{踏|ふ}まえた{提案|ていあん}です。
examples.english: This is a proposal based on past experience.

examples.japanese: その{点|てん}を{踏|ふ}まえて、もう{一度|いちど}{検討|けんとう}してください。
examples.english: Please reconsider with that point in mind.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From {踏|ふ}む (to step on) - figuratively "standing on" something as a foundation

TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive) - takes a を object

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜を{踏|ふ}まえて - based on ~, considering ~
・〜を{踏|ふ}まえた + noun - a ~ based on...

REGISTER:
Often used in formal or business contexts when discussing decisions or proposals based on certain factors.

RELATED:
・{基|もと}づく - to be based on
・{考慮|こうりょ}する - to consider
・{前提|ぜんてい}とする - to premise on
